verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents background automations users configure themselves. Incident Workflows use configurable "if-this-then-that" triggers and actions and can fire automatically, for example on every P1/P2 incident. Event Orchestration deduplicates and suppresses alerts automatically, and escalation policies assign incidents without anyone stepping in. On the agentic side, the Shift Agent coordinates schedule changes "without manual intervention" and the SRE Agent handles incidents, with configurable Skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI agents actually run autonomously, and evidence of general scheduled or time-based automations beyond incident and event triggers.
